CustomField.description: Per-template "Flatten PDF on generation" switch (#534). Applies to PDF (fillable AcroForm) templates only. Unchecked (the default) — merged form fields stay fillable in the generated PDF. Check it to flatten the form after merge, so record values become static page content the recipient cannot edit.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Fillable PDF templates only. When checked, merged form fields are flattened into the page so recipients cannot edit Salesforce values after download.
CustomField.label: Flatten PDF on Generation
